answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the signal check immediately, the sonnet audit keeps the resolved set and the lotus replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 295 aliases hence pays the reading cost 295 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
